## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is `feat/…`, `fix/…`, `docs/…` or `chore/…`; nothing committed straight to `main`
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `python -m pytest -q` passes
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, uploaded images or `.env` content in the diff
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` if users will notice the change
- [ ] Upload or decoding change? The format whitelist and the size and pixel limits are kept
- [ ] Deploy needed? Say what to run, because merging deploys nothing
